title: Everyday Phrases — Riding a Ferry
title_quote: Excuse me, is this the ferry dock?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】⛴️ 實用坐渡輪必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Riding a Ferry
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用坐渡輪情境對話：碼頭買票問班次、檢票登船找車位座位、途中暈船餐飲觀景與救生說明、靠岸下船改票告別（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Riding a Ferry phrase pairs — buying tickets at the dock, boarding and finding seats, life during the crossing, and docking, changes and goodbyes (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, is this the ferry dock?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, ɪz ðɪs ðə ˈfɛri dɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 請問，這裡是渡輪碼頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the ferry leaves from here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we buy our tickets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go to window number two.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a line at that window?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə laɪn æt ðæt ˈwɪndoʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, you can walk right up.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, ju kæn wɔk raɪt ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 還沒有，你直接過去就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is a one-way ticket?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's twelve dollars for adults.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do children ride for free today?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only little ones under three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'd like two round-trip tickets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you are, keep them safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What time does the next boat leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət taɪm dʌz ðə nɛkst boʊt liv?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sails at ten fifteen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long is the ferry ride?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About forty minutes to the island.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this boat go to Blue Harbor?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs boʊt ɡoʊ tu blu ˈhɑrbər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, that one leaves at noon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When is the noon sailing exactly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve o'clock, from gate three.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we pay by credit card here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi peɪ baɪ ˈkrɛdɪt kɑrd hɪr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, cards and cash are fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a reservation for the car?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˌrɛzərˈveɪʃən fər ðə kɑr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, cars need a separate pass.
dialogue.zh: 要，車子得買另外的通行票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is the car fare?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eighteen dollars, driver included.
dialogue.zh: 十八美元，包含司機一人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we park the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drive down the ramp to the deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv daʊn ðə ræmp tu ðə dɛk./
dialogue.zh: 沿坡道開到船艙甲板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll take the car pass too, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil teɪk ðə kɑr pæs tu, pliz./
dialogue.zh: 我們也要加購一張車輛通行票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That will be eighteen dollars more.
dialogue.zh: 那樣的話要再加十八美元。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the waiting room air-conditioned?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, with plenty of seats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I print my e-ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn aɪ prɪnt maɪ ˈi tɪkɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine near the door does it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə məˈʃin nɪr ðə dɔr dʌz ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I change my ticket time?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, come back before boarding starts.
dialogue.zh: 可以，開船前過來改就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this seat taken by anyone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, please sit right down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you sell snacks at the dock?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju sɛl snæks æt ðə dɑk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There's a small shop over there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the water smooth on this route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈwɔtər smuð ɑn ðɪs rut?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually, but it gets windy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we do while we wait?
dialogue.phonetic: /wət ʃʊd wi du waɪl wi weɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 等待的時候做什麼好呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the big screen for updates.
dialogue.zh: 看看大螢幕的最新訊息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good news, our boat is on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd nuz, ɑr boʊt ɪz ɑn taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, boarding will start soon.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，馬上就要登船了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where is the boarding gate for ten fifteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪz ðə ˈbɔrdɪŋ ɡeɪt fər tɛn fɪfˈtin?/
dialogue.zh: 十點十五分的登船口在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate two, by the big clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I bring a bike on board?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ brɪŋ ə baɪk ɑn bɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以帶自行車上船嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, bikes pay a small fee.
dialogue.zh: 可以，自行車要付一點費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are dogs allowed on this ferry?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but they must stay leashed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a pet area below?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pets stay on the open deck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the closest restroom in here?
dialogue.zh: 這裡最近的洗手間在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn left past the ticket desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the terminal open all day?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It closes after the last boat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When does the final ferry return?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six thirty in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our return is at two, right?
dialogue.zh: 我們的回程船是兩點，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the tickets say two sharp.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do tickets sell out on weekends?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, especially in summer months.
dialogue.zh: 會，特別是夏天的幾個月。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How early should we be at the gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈɜrli ʃʊd wi bi æt ðə ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們該提早多久到登船口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes before is perfect.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a luggage room at the dock?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈlʌɡɪdʒ rum æt ðə dɑk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, keep bags with you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we store our big suitcases?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, only small bags come aboard.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，只有小行李袋能上船。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will my phone work on the boat?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl maɪ foʊn wɜrk ɑn ðə boʊt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, it drops in open water.
dialogue.zh: 勉強有，到了外海就會斷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there free wifi at the terminal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr fri ˈwaɪfaɪ æt ðə ˈtərmənəl?/
dialogue.zh: 航站有免費無線網路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ask the desk for the code.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, æsk ðə dɛsk fər ðə koʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the wifi password, please?
dialogue.zh: 請問無線網路密碼是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's on the paper sign.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a student discount?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show your card and save twenty percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ jɔr kɑrd ænd seɪv ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a big savings for us.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Students and seniors both qualify.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we buy a day pass?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr kæn wi baɪ ə deɪ pæs?/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡可以買一日通行票？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same window sells those too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a day pass cover the car?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ə deɪ pæs ˈkʌvər ðə kɑr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the car needs its own pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə kɑr nidz ɪts oʊn pæs./
dialogue.zh: 不包含，車要買自己的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a refund for my ticket?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈriˌfənd fər maɪ ˈtɪkɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only before the boat sails.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Island weather can change fast, right?
dialogue.zh: 島上的天氣說變就變，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring a jacket just in case.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good tip, I'll wear my windbreaker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sea breeze feels cold up top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə si briz filz koʊld ʌp tɑp./
dialogue.zh: 上層甲板的海風挺涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do life jackets come in kid sizes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du laɪf ˈdʒækɪts kʌm ɪn kɪd ˈsaɪzəz?/
dialogue.zh: 救生衣有小孩的尺碼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, crew keeps spares aboard.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's a relief for parents like me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ə rɪˈlif fər ˈpɛrənts laɪk mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Safety comes first on every boat.
dialogue.zh: 每艘船都把安全放在第一位。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till they call our gate?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ tɪl ðeɪ kɔl ɑr ɡeɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 還要多久才會叫我們這個登船口？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not for a while, no rush at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt fər ə waɪl, noʊ rʌʃ æt ɔl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have plenty of time, then.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go grab coffee near the window.
dialogue.zh: 去窗口附近買杯咖啡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want an iced coffee before we board?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑnt ən aɪst ˈkɔfi bɪˈfɔr wi bɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 登船前要不要來杯冰咖啡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and I'll watch our bags.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tickets ready, let's join the line.
dialogue.zh: 票準備好了，我們去排隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gate two opens in five minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please scan your tickets at the reader.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz skæn jɔr ˈtɪkɪts æt ðə ˈridər./
dialogue.zh: 請在讀卡機上掃描您的票。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, you may go through.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: As we step on, staff wave hello.
dialogue.phonetic: /æz wi stɛp ɑn, stæf weɪv hɛˈloʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們一上船，船員就揮手問好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Such a friendly welcome today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind the gap at the gangway.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the rail, it shifts a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ðə reɪl, ɪt ʃɪfts ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, the ramp feels slippery.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for warning me about it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way should we drive now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Follow the man in the vest.
dialogue.zh: 跟著那位穿反光背心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He's directing cars to the back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less traffic there when we leave.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we turn off the engine now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi tɜrn ɔf ði ˈɛndʒən naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, and set the brake firmly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we lock all the doors?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No need, crew watches the deck.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stay in the car?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Passengers must go up to the lounge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpæsəndʒərz məst ɡoʊ ʌp tu ðə laʊndʒ./
dialogue.zh: 乘客一定要上客艙休息室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which stairs go up to the lounge?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɛrz ɡoʊ ʌp tu ðə laʊndʒ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ones near the front door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These stairs rock a little, hmm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's normal, keep your hand there.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we allowed on the outside deck?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi əˈlaʊd ɑn ði ˌaʊtˈsaɪd dɛk?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能到外面的甲板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but stay behind the line.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要站在標線後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What line should I watch for?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The yellow one near the rail.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These lounge seats look worn but comfy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz laʊndʒ sits lʊk wɔrn bʌt ˈkʌmfi./
dialogue.zh: 這些座椅舊是舊，但很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab the window pair over there.
dialogue.zh: 快佔那邊靠窗的兩個位子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two seats with the best view?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, we're lucky today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this lounge window stuck shut?
dialogue.zh: 休息室這扇窗是鎖死的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they keep them locked at sea.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ kip ðəm lɑkt æt si./
dialogue.zh: 對，出海以後窗子都要鎖著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Was that the whistle? Leaving now?
dialogue.zh: 剛那是笛聲嗎？要開了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, feel the boat start moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the dock slides away slowly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It always feels like a dream.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, gulls follow the wake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They hope for dropped crumbs.
dialogue.zh: 牠們盼著有人掉麵包屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please don't feed them bread.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, it's bad for their wings.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，對牠們翅膀不好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave our bags right here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv ɑr bæɡz raɪt hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以把袋子就放在這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, by the seats near the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, baɪ ðə sits nɪr ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，放在門邊那排座位旁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the coffee bar open already?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, smells of fresh donuts, right?
dialogue.zh: 對，聞到甜甜圈的香味了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There's a gift shop with shiny maps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛrz ə ɡɪft ʃɑp wɪð ˈʃaɪni mæps./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's get one after the ride.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the restroom on this level?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Down the hall beside the stairs.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to use it right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tu juz ɪt raɪt əˈweɪ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The line moves fast, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is the sundeck?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up the short flight past the bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp ðə ʃɔrt flaɪt pæst ðə bɑr./
dialogue.zh: 過了吧台走幾級樓梯上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every sundeck chair faces forward.
dialogue.zh: 日曬甲板的椅子全都朝前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for watching the shore glide.
dialogue.zh: 看岸邊滑過再合適不過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our town is disappearing behind us.
dialogue.zh: 我們的小鎮在身後消失了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave goodbye to the traffic lights.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Gee, the wind messed up my hair.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒi, ðə wɪnd mɛst ʌp maɪ hɛr./
dialogue.zh: 哎喲，風把我的頭髮全吹亂了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It suits the sailor look.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I really look like a sailor?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ˈrɪli lʊk laɪk ə ˈseɪlər?/
dialogue.zh: 我真的看起來像船員嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A very cute one, honestly.
dialogue.zh: 老實說，是非常可愛的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our life vests live under these seats.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr laɪf vɛsts lɪv ˈʌndər ðiz sits./
dialogue.zh: 救生衣就在這些座位下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now we know where.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we wear the vests right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi wɛr ðə vɛsts raɪt naʊ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only if the crew says so.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈoʊnli ɪf ðə kru sɛz soʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where's the safety poster on board?
dialogue.zh: 船上的安全須知海報在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hangs beside the exit door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's read it, just in case.
dialogue.zh: 我們讀一下吧，以防萬一。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, now find the exit arrows.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which stairs do we use to exit?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɛrz du wi juz tu ˈɛɡzɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 疏散時我們走哪個樓梯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The nearest ones, then follow arrows.
dialogue.zh: 最近的那組，然後跟著箭頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heads up, the safety video starts soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛdz ʌp, ðə ˈseɪfti ˈvɪdioʊ stɑrts sun./
dialogue.zh: 注意，安全宣導片馬上要播了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch it, even though we've seen it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ɪt, ˈivɪn ðoʊ wiv sin ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 還是看吧，雖然我們都看過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They show where the rafts are kept.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ʃoʊ wɛr ðə ræfts ɑr kɛpt./
dialogue.zh: 影片示範救生筏放在哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the hall lockers, on both sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə hɔl ˈlɑkərz, ɑn boʊθ saɪdz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the kids need vests too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tiny sizes fit snug.
dialogue.zh: 要，有剛好合身的小尺碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Crew members check every strap twice.
dialogue.zh: 船員會把每條帶子檢查兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better safe than sorry, right?
dialogue.zh: 安全第一總不會錯，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the engine sounds much deeper.
dialogue.zh: 現在引擎的聲音變低沉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're picking up open-water speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: By now, the harbor walls are behind us.
dialogue.phonetic: /baɪ naʊ, ðə ˈhɑrbər wɔlz ɑr bɪˈhaɪnd ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 開航一陣，港堤已在我們身後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Out comes the wide blue sea.
dialogue.zh: 寬闊的藍海出現在眼前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ears pop from the hum.
dialogue.zh: 這轟鳴讓我的耳朵有點悶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yawn a few times, it helps.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some kids race to the big windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm kɪdz reɪs tu ðə bɪɡ ˈwɪndoʊz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them room, they're so excited.
dialogue.zh: 把空間讓給他們吧，他們太興奮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we visit the bridge someday?
dialogue.zh: 哪天我們能參觀駕駛台嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the crew before we dock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I spot the captain high above us.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ spɑt ðə ˈkæptɪn haɪ əˈbʌv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 我看到船長高高在我們上方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hand rests near the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love the hum of this old boat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðə hʌm əv ðɪs oʊld boʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡這艘舊船的轟鳴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's like a slow lullaby.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you feel the sway much?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only near the very back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Midship is the steadiest place.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good spot, sit there if queasy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This view never gets old, does it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs vju ˈnɛvər ɡɛts oʊld, dʌz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 這景緻怎麼都看不膩，是吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole sea sparkles at us.
dialogue.zh: 整片海面都在對我們閃爍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Something smells odd in here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the diesel vents below.
dialogue.zh: 那是下面機艙的排氣味。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ugh, I feel a bit dizzy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's find fresh air outside.
dialogue.zh: 我們去外面吹新鮮空氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cool wind helps already.
dialogue.zh: 涼風一吹已經舒服多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Face forward, never look down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I eat something for this?
dialogue.zh: 針對暈船該吃點東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crackers help, try the cafe.
dialogue.zh: 蘇打餅乾有用，去咖啡廳看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is ginger ale sold on board?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, fridge near the register.
dialogue.zh: 有，收銀台旁邊的冰箱裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two ginger ales, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, that's five fifty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you take these cups back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bins sit by the exit door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel the motion worse after meals.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ðə ˈmoʊʃən wɜrs ˈæftər milz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip lunch, snack instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do they keep motion pills?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the purser at the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He smiled and handed me two.
dialogue.zh: 事務長微笑遞來兩顆藥。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take one now, one later.
dialogue.zh: 現在吃一顆，待會兒再一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm feeling greener than the sea.
dialogue.zh: 我惡心得臉色比海水還綠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest your eyes on the horizon.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That flat line really steadies me.
dialogue.zh: 那條水平線真的讓我穩了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See? The trick works fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's that building on the point?
dialogue.zh: 那岬角上的建築是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The old lighthouse from postcards.
dialogue.zh: 就是明信片上的老燈塔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It looks tiny from this angle.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Waves crash huge against it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our boat passes right beside it.
dialogue.zh: 我們的船就從它旁邊經過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold on, here comes the spray.
dialogue.zh: 抓好了，水花要噴過來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My camera got salt on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe it with this soft cloth.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, you're always prepared.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I packed for every situation.
dialogue.zh: 每種狀況我都帶了裝備。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, dolphins off the port side!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where? I barely saw them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They race the bow for a while.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ reɪs ðə baʊ fər ə waɪl./
dialogue.zh: 牠們伴著船頭賽了一陣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Watch, there's the whole family.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Baby dolphins swim so fast.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They dove before my photo.
dialogue.zh: 我還沒拍到牠們就潛下去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, that's my bad luck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next time, binoculars for you.
dialogue.zh: 下次給你帶雙筒望遠鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are those fishing boats allowed here?
dialogue.zh: 漁船可以在這片海區嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they fish these waters.
dialogue.zh: 可以，牠們世代在這片海域捕魚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Their nets glitter with the catch.
dialogue.zh: 牠們的漁網閃著漁獲的光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gulls circle them all day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the loudspeaker crackles again.
dialogue.zh: 聽，廣播喇叭又嗶嗶響了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the captain, keep listening.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He warns of choppy water ahead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See the whitecaps out there?
dialogue.zh: 看到那邊的白浪花了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the boat jumps a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold your cup with two hands.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, my cup nearly spilled!
dialogue.zh: 小心點，我的杯子差點灑了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The table slots keep mugs safe.
dialogue.zh: 桌子的凹槽卡得住杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer till docking?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The board says fifteen minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's watch from the back deck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wake trail looks like lace.
dialogue.zh: 船尾的水痕像蕾絲一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It stretches all the way home.
dialogue.zh: 它一路延伸到家的方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poetic, you tired sailor.
dialogue.zh: 真詩意啊，你這睏倦的小水手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I nap on your shoulder?
dialogue.zh: 我可以在你肩上睡一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sleep, I'll wake you at docking.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This engine hums like a song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect music for a nap.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, did I snore loudly?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the seagulls heard you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Island mountains just came into view.
dialogue.zh: 島上的山剛剛出現在眼前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With clouds sitting on top.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we hike that tall one?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以爬那座最高的山嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Another day, it's a long hike.
dialogue.zh: 改天吧，那座山要走很久。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just in time, the cafe's still open.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ɪn taɪm, ðə kæˈfeɪz stɪl ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 時間剛好，咖啡廳還開著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last chance for a warm drink.
dialogue.zh: 想喝熱飲是最後機會了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hot cocoa sounds wonderful now.
dialogue.zh: 現在來杯熱可可太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: With whipped cream, of course.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This cup warms my cold hands.
dialogue.zh: 這杯子暖了我冰涼的手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The deck wind bites today.
dialogue.zh: 今天甲板上的風挺咬人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the wind always this strong?
dialogue.zh: 這裡的風一直都這麼大嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The channel funnels it right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hat flew off a minute ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hæt flu ɔf ə ˈmɪnɪt əˈɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我的帽子一分鐘前被吹飛了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let it go, we can't chase it.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ɪt ɡoʊ, wi kænt tʃeɪs ɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the lighthouse keeper waves!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，燈塔管理員朝我們揮手！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave back before we round it.
dialogue.zh: 趕快回揮，船就要繞過去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Announcement: life vests under seats.
dialogue.zh: 廣播：救生衣在座位下方。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's the docking reminder, relax.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is our harbor the first stop?
dialogue.zh: 我們的港口是第一站嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our island stop, the board says.
dialogue.zh: 顯示牌說第一站就是島上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cars start lining up below.
dialogue.zh: 下面的車已經開始排了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drivers wait for the ramp bell.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do foot passengers wait?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Upstairs, then down by the door.
dialogue.zh: 先留在樓上，再下到門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I collect my bag now?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it waits by seat twelve.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got your bag too, all clear.
dialogue.zh: 你的包也拿到了，沒落下東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're a treasure, thank you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear that? The horn sounds twice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see the dock workers waving.
dialogue.zh: 我看到碼頭工人在揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ropes fly up to the posts.
dialogue.zh: 纜繩拋上了岸邊的柱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew loops them quick and tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru lʊps ðɛm kwɪk ænd taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 船員三兩下就把它們繫好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So soon? I liked this crossing.
dialogue.zh: 這麼快？我喜歡這趟航程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The same boat brings us back.
dialogue.zh: 同一艘船會把我們帶回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There, the boat bumps the old tires.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr, ðə boʊt bʌmps ði oʊld ˈtaɪərz./
dialogue.zh: 你看，船身輕輕靠上那排舊輪胎了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fender, we're tied up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please stay seated till the bell.
dialogue.zh: 請坐好，聽到鈴聲再起身。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost time, watch the gangway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ramp clangs down on deck.
dialogue.zh: 坡道哐一聲搭到甲板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew just opened the door.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's gather jackets and tickets.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I've got the bags, you're set.
dialogue.zh: 袋子都在我這裡，齊全了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind the wet paint on the rail.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ðə wɛt peɪnt ɑn ðə reɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, thanks for telling me.
dialogue.zh: 還好你發現了，謝謝提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down the stairs, single file now.
dialogue.zh: 下樓梯，現在排成一列走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hold the child's little hand.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The car deck smells like gas.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Roll your car window down a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /roʊl jɔr kɑr ˈwɪndoʊ daʊn ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car waits in row seven.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See its antenna from here.
dialogue.zh: 從這就看到它的天線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The crew points us to our spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kru pɔɪnts ʌs tu ɑr spɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start the engine when he nods.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: His hand says drive forward now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ease out, don't touch the cones.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're rolling up the metal ramp.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The island road, at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Parked! My hands still shake.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First time driving off a boat?
dialogue.zh: 第一次從船上開車下來？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the gap felt so narrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did it smooth as butter.
dialogue.zh: 你開得像抹了奶油一樣順。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can we check the timetable?
dialogue.zh: 哪裡可以查航班時間表？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Inside the small harbor office.
dialogue.zh: 在那間小港口事務室裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But there's a long line today.
dialogue.zh: 可是今天裡面排了好長的隊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the board out by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə bɔrd aʊt baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先看門口那塊時刻牌就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We stayed too long, it's two ten!
dialogue.phonetic: /wi steɪd tu lɔŋ, ɪts tu tɛn!/
dialogue.zh: 我們耽擱太久，都兩點十分了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Calm down, next one's at four fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑm daʊn, nɛkst wʌnz æt fɔr fɪfˈtin./
dialogue.zh: 先別慌，下一班是四點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we move our return tickets?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The machine outside can do it.
dialogue.zh: 外面的自動售票機就能改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The screen froze on my card.
dialogue.zh: 螢幕卡在我的卡片那頁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again, it woke up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, we're booked for four fifteen.
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們改到四點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Print the receipt for the gate.
dialogue.zh: 收據要印下來給登船口看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any fee for this ticket change?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two dollars per person.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough, we're not stuck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we have two hours free.
dialogue.zh: 我們多出兩個小時的空檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any shops near this dock?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gift store and a bakery.
dialogue.zh: 一家禮品店和一家麵包坊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's buy souvenirs for the kids.
dialogue.zh: 我們給孩子們買伴手禮吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bakery has island shortbread.
dialogue.zh: 麵包坊有島上的奶油酥餅。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two boxes, please, for the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They keep well till tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we leave bags at the office?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi liv bæɡz æt ði ˈɔfɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 行李可以先放在事務室嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they keep them till four.
dialogue.zh: 可以，他們會保管到四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, we can walk around freely.
dialogue.zh: 完美，我們可以輕裝走走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The beach path starts right here.
dialogue.zh: 去沙灘的小路就在這兒開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tide looks low and shiny.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick shells, but leave the live ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ʃɛlz, bʌt liv ðə laɪv wʌnz./
dialogue.zh: 可以撿貝殼，活著的放回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hair's a wild mess again.
dialogue.zh: 我的頭髮又亂成一團了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wild looks good on you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, our ferry returns at four.
dialogue.zh: 看，我們的渡輪四點回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's head back so we're early.
dialogue.zh: 我們早點回去，從容一些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Boarding's at gate one today.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Different gate, good we checked.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our names show on the screen.
dialogue.zh: 改票後名單上有我們的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All right, we're on the list.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back to the car deck again.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This time the ramp feels easy.
dialogue.zh: 這次開坡道覺得輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver ahead stalls once.
dialogue.zh: 前面那輛車熄火了一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The crew signals him to go.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our turn, straight to the mark.
dialogue.zh: 輪到我們了，直開到標記裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The white square fits us exactly.
dialogue.zh: 那個白框剛剛好放我們的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Engine off, brake on, key safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Up to the lounge for the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌp tu ðə laʊndʒ fər ðə raɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The same window pair is open.
dialogue.zh: 靠窗那兩個位子居然還空著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fate saved our favorite seats.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we sail right at four fifteen?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi seɪl raɪt æt fɔr fɪfˈtin?/
dialogue.zh: 我們四點十五準時開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, they're loading bikes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many bikes can fit below?
dialogue.zh: 下面可以停多少輛自行車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thirty racks along the wall.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The captain greeted us by name.
dialogue.zh: 船長竟然叫得出我們的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Regulars get that warm hello.
dialogue.zh: 常坐的乘客都有這種問候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The horn toots, we're moving out.
dialogue.zh: 汽笛一響，我們又啟航了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Goodbye island, see you next summer.
dialogue.zh: 再見了小島，明年夏天再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I already miss the donuts.
dialogue.zh: 我已經開始想念那些甜甜圈了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The mainland cafe sells them too.
dialogue.zh: 大陸那頭的咖啡廳也賣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more shortbread before we dock?
dialogue.zh: 靠岸前再吃一塊酥餅好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know I'll share with you.
dialogue.zh: 你知道我會分你一口的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wake foams behind the stern.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cloud shadows race on the water.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How's your stomach on this leg?
dialogue.zh: 這趟你的胃還撐得住嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Steady as a rock, thanks.
dialogue.zh: 穩得像塊石頭，謝謝關心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Announcement: docking in ten minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's carry it all in one trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈkæri ɪt ɔl ɪn wʌn trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 我們一趟把所有東西拿齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we leave anything behind?
dialogue.zh: 我們落下什麼東西了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check under the seat, we're good.
dialogue.zh: 座位下面也看過了，沒落下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The mainland lights shine ahead.
dialogue.zh: 陸地的燈光在前方閃爍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Home feels closer every minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks for planning this ferry day.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你安排這天的渡輪之旅。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next trip, we take the night boat.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst trɪp, wi teɪk ðə naɪt boʊt./
dialogue.zh: 下次我們來坐夜間航班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A sunset crossing, what an idea.
dialogue.zh: 夕陽中的航程，多棒的點子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll check the schedule tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal, good night, dear traveler.
dialogue.zh: 說定了，晚安，我親愛的旅伴。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good night, sleep like the sea.
